title: Two habitats, one life
hook: A frog may use more than one habitat during its life.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The schematic places tadpoles in water and an adult frog on adjacent land. This is a typical example, not a rule for every frog; some species develop directly or use other habitats.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In a typical two-habitat example, where are the aquatic tadpoles shown?

claims.text: A frog may use more than one habitat during its life. In a typical two-habitat example, where are the aquatic tadpoles shown?
